question: Q3
source_derivation: Charge/white-line relationships associated with Figs. 8–9; predictive comparison extends the source analysis.
illustrative_analysis: Compare full absorption vectors with photon energy at maximum absorption using independently validation-selected nonlinear regressors. Estimate paired uncertainty on charge prediction differences.
illustrative_design: Inspect source labels, material IDs and target availability; use available-ID material groups with two approximately 60/20/20 train/validation/test holdouts; train ExtraTrees with 80 trees and validation-selected leaf size 1 or 5. Report conditional group-bootstrap intervals, training-only baselines and source-selection limits. These are example choices only.
executed_finding: Full-spectrum charge MAE is lower in 16/16 paired holdouts; 16 conditional intervals favor full spectra. The inference is conditional on learner and identified source population.
solver_input_boundary: Only the standalone prompt and eight input files. Evaluator materials and the review site must be inaccessible during a benchmark attempt.
